title: bug: list_metrics sinceIso keys an in-flight task on metrics.firstClaimAt, its oldest lifecycle stamp, so a WORKING, REVIEW or BLOCKED row first claimed before the cutoff but touched after it is dropped, where the schema and MCP_SERVER.md promise the most recent timestamp
description:
Filed by hunt task-afe61cc0 (2026-11-03 #11, lane 2: daemon read/query tools).

PROBLEM
- filterTasksForMetrics (packages/moe-daemon/src/util/metrics.ts:111-131) keys the sinceIso cutoff on `t.metrics?.doneAt ?? t.metrics?.firstClaimAt ?? t.updatedAt ?? t.createdAt` (:122-125).
- For a claimed task that is not done, firstClaimAt is its OLDEST lifecycle stamp. So a WORKING, REVIEW or BLOCKED row first claimed before the cutoff is dropped, however recently it was touched.
- The contract says the opposite, in three places:
  - the list_metrics schema (src/tools/listMetrics.ts:21): "only tasks last touched at/after this time are included";
  - docs/MCP_SERVER.md's moe.list_metrics notes: "sinceIso uses the most recent lifecycle timestamp available on each task, so in-flight tasks aren't excluded just because they haven't reached DONE";
  - the code's own comment (metrics.ts:120-121): "Use the most recent lifecycle timestamp available".
- The IDE metrics range calls the same function (/ws GET_METRICS, src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:993).

EVIDENCE
1. Repro on HEAD 31492ac5, run in a git-archive snapshot outside the shared checkout: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-afe61cc0/B/zzHuntB_metricsSince.test.ts, verbatim output in zzHuntB_metricsSince.output.txt. A WORKING row first claimed 48 h ago and updated 1 h ago, queried with a 24 h sinceIso:
   stored updatedAt 2026-11-03T19:34:54.621Z firstClaimAt 2026-11-01T20:34:54.621Z sinceIso 2026-11-02T20:34:54.621Z => totalMatched 0
   AssertionError: expected +0 to be 1
2. Live board at 2026-11-03T20:40Z: 4 of the 9 in-flight rows fall out of a 24 h window, although each was updated within the last 2 hours:
   - 23c803d2 WORKING (firstClaimAt 2026-11-01T18:55Z, updatedAt 2026-11-03T19:29Z);
   - 62ec51f1 WORKING (11-01T14:15Z / 11-03T19:19Z);
   - 828e7d21 REVIEW (11-01T12:25Z / 11-03T20:02Z);
   - d861f3de BLOCKED (11-01T18:54Z / 11-03T19:07Z).

FIX DIRECTION
- Key the cutoff on `metrics.doneAt ?? updatedAt ?? metrics.firstClaimAt ?? createdAt`.
- doneAt stays first, so a DONE row whose updatedAt is bumped later (a comment, a board edit, an archive) is not pulled back into the window. Every other row uses updatedAt, which is never older than firstClaimAt.
- Leave the per-task sort order alone: MCP_SERVER.md documents doneAt → firstClaimAt → updatedAt → createdAt for sorting.
- Do not edit docs/MCP_SERVER.md (task-0adea941 holds it): the fix makes its note true.

FILES
- packages/moe-daemon/src/util/metrics.ts
- packages/moe-daemon/src/util/metrics.test.ts
